node.statement: Because W.K3>=1 and epsilon>=0, t_3=W.K3*epsilon satisfies 0<=epsilon<=t_3. Multiplying epsilon<=W.e_cross/W.K3 by the positive W.K3 gives t_3<=W.e_cross<=e_cross^0. Also W.K3>=K_3^0>=e_cross^0/e_env^0 and W.e_cross<=e_cross^0 imply epsilon<=W.e_cross/W.K3<=e_env^0, so the direct-envelope smallness hypothesis holds.
